basic_info.description: A wonderful opportunity to acquire the NE corner Penthouse at The Austin with rare TWO car parking. This outstanding view residence offers a split bedroom layout with captivating vistas in all directions. Enjoy floor-to-ceiling windows and 9.5ft ceiling height. Sleek kitchen appliances include a built-in 30" Liebherr refrigerator, Miele gas cooktop and oven, Zephyr hood and Bosch dishwasher. This elegant home showcases views of Downtown, Nob Hill, Russian Hill, Angel Island and Tiburon in the distance. Wide plank oak floors accentuate the elegance of the open living floor plan. The primary bedroom with walk-through closet leads to a private and serene en-suite bathroom. The north facing guest bedroom (currently used as a dining room) has a murphy bed for flexible use of this space to fit your personal needs. A guest bath is down the hallway where you'll find an extra large closet for storage needs. Modern conveniences such as motorized shades, custom California Closets, central air conditioning/heating, in-unit laundry and abundant closet space ensure stress-free living in a comfortable environment. The Austin offers 24 hour front desk personnel, a resident lounge and garden, bike storage, dog washing station and an impressive roof terrace equipped with BBQ (and more views!).
